summary: 65-year-old male skier missing at Jones Pass; a SARDOC air-scent dog team worked Jones Pass Road and the subject's body was located some distance from where the team was working.
responding_agency: SARDOC (dog-team assist); county search team unnamed in summary
notes: SARDOC 2018 public mission summaries (parent-opened this run). Cause of death not stated. Jones Pass on the Clear Creek/Grand County line.
